newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM continues search for European partner.
newsitem.headline: KLM continues search for European partner.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines was continuing its search for a European partner airline but had nothing firm to announce for the time being, KLM chairman Pieter Bouw told reporters on Tuesday.
Bouw made his remarks at a news conference where KLM announced its second quarter 1996/97 results and a new cost-cutting programme dubbed Focus 2000.
"The Focus 2000 programme is essential if we are to make our KLM as strong as possible. In addition, we need a European partner," Bouw said.
